headline_seed: Alligator Alcatraz held detainees in cages the size of phone booths, DHS watchdog says - The Guardian
draft_text:
A DHS watchdog found 79 detainees held in 18-sq-ft metal cages at Florida's "Alligator Alcatraz" — less than half the ICE minimum. Axios reports staff called them "calming areas." A spokesperson said: "We'd make it even smaller if we could."

And that's the mews.
